Privacy and visit tracking

Your questions, saved readings, names, and birth details are processed on your device. They are not sent to the visit counter.

The public website counts page views and anonymous browser-tab sessions. A random session ID is stored in session storage and renewed after 30 minutes of inactivity. The counter stores the UTC day, section name, random session ID, and first-seen time. It does not store IP addresses, full URLs, referrers, or reading inputs. The hosting provider still processes network requests to deliver the website.

Session IDs outside the last 30 UTC days are removed during subsequent recorded visits; aggregate page-view totals remain. Sessions are estimates of visits and cannot identify individual people. The installed Windows and Android apps do not send visit analytics.

Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are respected. You can also turn off counting for this browser below.

Clearing browser storage resets this preference. Tracking blockers or offline browsing may prevent a visit from being counted.
